visualCharacteristics.purpose: Resource link list (or body copy / expandable feature list) beside one or more bordered cross-sell cards

contentPattern.structure: one row: first cell is the lead column (heading plus link list, body copy, or with accordion sub-headings each followed by their content); each further cell is a bordered card (optional image, heading, text, trailing link paragraph as the CTA). With feature-panels every cell is an equal panel

reuseGuidance: Use at the foot of product pages for 'Resources' links plus cross-sell boxes. Use columns-text for plain equal text columns, cards-product for product tile grids, accordion-faq for standalone FAQs.
